Bea · Berco character 01 · identity pack

Internal review, not for publishing. A synthetic person: never named, never presented as a client. Built 2 November 2026.
Who: Filipina, about 47, the woman of the house. Cast older because women 45 and over start half of all Berco conversations.
Element: BEA-Berco, reusable in Nano Banana, Seedance, Kling and Cinema Studio. Every scene states one Look word for word, because the Element locks the face, not the clothes.
Checks: each image read against the master at full resolution, plus a face-matching score (ArcFace). Bar: 0.60 for the pack, 0.55 for scenes.
Spent: about 30 credits for the whole pack.

Master portrait

The truth: every image of Bea is checked against this one. Passed by Jumbo 2 Nov. Marks: small mole right side of neck below the jaw; freckle scatter high on her left cheekbone. Hair parted on her left.

Head turnaround

Front, two left three-quarters, left profile, back of head (hair construction). Face match: front 0.87, three-quarters 0.73 to 0.76, profile 0.62.

Right three-quarter

Re-done after the first attempt faced the wrong way and mirrored the mole. Nose to the right, right ear, mole on the correct side. Face match 0.60.

Right profile

Right profile (right panel) shows the neck mole in place. The left panel is the rejected attempt, kept for the record. Profile match 0.57; side-on always scores lowest.

Look A · Morning cooking

Oat ribbed knit, ivory wide-leg linen, barefoot. Elegant and covered. Front 0.83, three-quarter 0.74.

Wardrobe · day (Look B options)

Left to right: cream silk set · camel knit column · oat linen-silk tunic set. Awaiting Jumbo's pick for Look B.

Wardrobe · evening (Look C chosen 2 Nov)

Left to right: champagne silk column · espresso crepe column · ivory crepe jumpsuit = Look C, Jumbo's pick. Replaces the old blouse look.

Expression range

Neutral 0.86 · contentment 0.87 · absorbed 0.79 · laugh 0.72 (came out as a wink, so re-done below) · listening 0.73 · relief 0.79.

The laugh (the break)

Both eyes closed into creases, head tipped back, real teeth, hair moving. The reel's key shot. Face match 0.64.

Hands

For the close-ups: veins, knuckle creases, forearm freckles, short natural nails, wedding band and solitaire on the LEFT ring finger.

Test frame in a real Berco kitchen

Element BEA-Berco placed into our own render (cream island, oak, glass units, arched window). Look A held, rings on the left hand, no invented badges at full resolution. Face match 0.55, exactly on the keyframe bar (eyes down costs points). The room is a faithful re-render, not a pixel copy, which is why the reel uses real clips when cabinetry is the subject.
